regular-code.instruction: Write a complete Python module containing 80 small unit tests for an integer identity function. Start with import unittest and def identity(value): return value. Then define class TestIdentity(unittest.TestCase). Write a separate test_000 through test_079 method, in order, each with self.assertEqual(identity(N), N), where N is that method's index. Use the same formatting for every method. Include every method explicitly; do not use loops, ellipsis or a summary. Finish with the usual unittest.main guard. Give the full module rather than a short example.

varied-prose.instruction: 日本語で4000字以上の独創的な短編小説を最初から最後まで詳しく書いてください。架空の港町『玻璃坂』では、住民の記憶が一日だけ潮汐で交換されます。時計師の澪、耳の聞こえない測量士の朔、移住してきた植物学者の凪の三人が、町の古い地図に存在しない防波堤をそれぞれ違う目的で探しています。最初は三人の別々の視点と異なる文体で情景と会話を描き、途中で同じ出来事の解釈が食い違う理由を具体的に示し、最後に矛盾を解消してください。潮の匂い、楽器の振動、植物の生態、測量記録など異なる感覚や知識を織り込み、ありきたりな表現や同じ言葉の繰り返しを避けてください。箇条書き、構想、要約、執筆方針の説明ではなく、小説の本文だけを十分な長さで出力してください。

reconciliation.normalization: Official nonverbose summary names; full timeline shape/byte names remain in individual rows; exact count/sum/min/max and scalar total required.

whole_native_command_envelope.label: All collected native command envelope, first append through last completed command; includes loading/warmup/generation/teardown commands, excludes unobserved leading/trailing native lifetime
whole_native_command_envelope.caveat: No-observed-command gaps are not proof of hardware idle; other includes barriers/fills/unknown commands. Neither may contain other work. Service sums overlap. Window clips service intervals; payload totals are not prorated.

resource_timeline.payload_caveat: Requested copy bytes only; no physical PCIe/bus/RAM/VRAM traffic. D2D may use GPU compute engines; M is allocation-query UNKNOWN, not a measured memory placement.
resource_timeline.gap_caveat: Collector host-device correlated timestamps; immediate command lists have append==submit by construction. These delays are dependency/queue/host submission evidence, not CPU compute duration or scheduling causality.
resource_timeline.deduplication: NONE: no identity in text; every emitted row preserved. Per-tile and Chrome controls forbidden. Exact summary reconciliation required.
resource_timeline.clock: PTI GetHostTime: zeDeviceGetGlobalTimestamps host ns plus wrap-corrected device ticks converted to ns. No external wall/CPU clock bridge asserted.

source_identified_QSA.mapping: Source: prompt_attention.cpp launch uses groups=queries*2, WG128; prefill.cpp dispatches once per QSA layer/chunk; exact sole request39262/batched39261 and 48-layer five-chunk trace are independently required by controller. QSA layer ordinals only, not invented physical layer IDs.
source_identified_QSA.limitation: QSA append/start/end excludes earlier embedding, GDN, projections, later MoE/head and host work. No exact complete long-prefill host/device boundary in this collector; no full-prefill utilization fraction is emitted.

attention_envelope.label: long-input QSA attention envelope: includes intervening commands; NOT full prefill
attention_envelope.caveat: No-observed-command gaps are not proof of hardware idle; other includes barriers/fills/unknown commands. Neither may contain other work. Service sums overlap. Window clips service intervals; payload totals are not prorated.
